@graph.dcterms:title: Data Freshness Quality Policy
@graph.dcterms:description: Policy ensuring data timeliness by constraining age of timestamp to maximum 30 minutes
@graph.dcterms:creator: Data Governance Team

permission.dcterms:title: Freshness-based Distribution Permission
permission.dcterms:description: Permission to distribute data if timestamp freshness constraint is met

constraint.dcterms:title: 30-Minute Freshness Constraint
constraint.dcterms:description: Data age must be less than or equal to 30 minutes

@graph.dcterms:title: Data Age Measurement
@graph.dcterms:description: Measurement of time elapsed since data creation (computed from timestamp)

dqv:isMeasurementOf.dcterms:title: Data Freshness Metric
dqv:isMeasurementOf.dcterms:description: Metric measuring how recent the data is

dqv:inDimension.rdfs:label: Timeliness
dqv:inDimension.rdfs:comment: The degree to which data is current and up-to-date (W3C DQV standard dimension)

dqv:computedOn.schema:name: Timestamp
dqv:computedOn.schema:description: Data collection timestamp (mapped from physical column 'ts')

prov:wasGeneratedBy.dcterms:description: Calculates time difference between current time and data timestamp
